entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain, and amounts may approach warning criteria. Rain easing from the south this afternoon. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Low. Changes: The risk of upgrade has been changed to low.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to affect the road into Thursday afternoon. 2 to 4 cm may accumulate near the summit, with lesser amounts down to 800 metres.
